confusions: Opening narrative is information-dense (mentions barrow, verses, crown, two NPCs, two paths, mechanics all at once); a player might miss key details. Notice board clarifies well, but frontloading that much upfront creates cognitive friction.
suggestions: Consider breaking up the opening scene description — lead with 'someone must end the blight' and let the notice board do the heavy lifting on systems
The barrow-wight felt like a tutorial encounter — Scholar with armor one-shot it after one miss. Consider tuning difficulty or adding harder variants for different builds
The hunter's camp and locked strongbox exist but the verse path didn't require them; consider hooks that naturally draw explorers there (or make them optional flavor)
Excellent use of faction choice without forcing commitment upfront; the gray priest blessing was elegant
